zh: 一個錢包可以記多種幣別：記帳時可以換幣別，不同幣別分開列出，不換算、不相加
管理錢包時可以改預設幣別；新增錢包的幣別改為可搜尋的選單
記一筆之後，首頁會提示「已記錄」
en: One wallet can now hold several currencies: pick a currency when adding an entry; each currency is listed on its own, never converted or added together
Change a wallet’s default currency when managing wallets; the currency field for new wallets is now a searchable menu
After saving an entry, the home screen confirms it was saved
New Taiwan dollar amounts no longer show “.00”
The app is now called Budget Book

zh: 備份改為更新同一個檔案，不會越存越多
新增月底自動備份（預設關閉）
en: Backups now update the same file instead of piling up
New: automatic backup at the end of each month (off by default)

zh: 備份提醒改為每月月底一次：使用滿 30 天才開始提醒，當月已備份就不提醒
預算進度條的外觀修正
en: Backup reminders now come once at the end of each month, starting after 30 days of use, and skip months you’ve already backed up
Fixed the look of the budget progress bar

zh: 首頁依日期分組，跨年時加上年份分隔；預算卡會隨列表一起捲動
記帳頁的日期改為日曆按鈕；寫備註時分類改成單列，畫面不擁擠
改善 TalkBack 的刪除操作
修正左滑刪除或還原後出現空白列
en: The home list is grouped by day, with a divider when the year changes; the budget card now scrolls with the list
The date on the add screen is now a calendar button; while writing a note, categories shrink to one row
Better TalkBack support for deleting entries
Fixed a blank row appearing after swiping to delete or undoing

zh: 分類改為兩列，並依你排的順序顯示
每週小計改為收入減支出的淨額
寫備註時收起數字鍵盤
en: Categories are shown in two rows, in the order you arranged them
Weekly subtotals now show income minus spending
The number pad hides while you write a note
The “Entertainment” category is renamed “Leisure”

zh: 第一個測試版本：多錢包、每週或總預算、統計、備份與還原、深色模式、中英文介面
設定頁可以打開「協助改善 App」（預設關閉），也可以支持開發者
en: First test release: multiple wallets, weekly or total budgets, stats, backup and restore, dark mode, English and Chinese
Optional “Help improve the app” switch in Settings (off by default), and a way to support the developer
New app icon
